Community Promotion Commission, May 20, 2024  Page 2 of 2
   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  April 8, 2024

Vice Chair Ang called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. Responding to roll call were Chair Leon,
Commissioner Beacham and Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Rosalee Santa Ana, Senior
Management Analyst and Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Commissioner Sanchez made the motion and Commissioner Beacham seconded to approve the
minutes for March 11, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Voting

Item 1: Chair Leon addressed the Commission explaining her circumstance for needing to attend the
meeting remotely via Zoom. Commissioners were asked if there were any objections to Chair Leon
joining via Zoom; There being no objection, the motion carried. Chair Leon asked Vice Chair Ang
to continue leading the meeting.

Item 2: Commissioner Beacham asked for clarification on the process of adding items to the
Commissions responsibilities. Mrs. Ocegueda stated that the members of the Commission vote when
an item is brought before them, and if passed, the item is added to the list of Commission meetings
and activities that is given to members at the beginning of the year. Any individual interested in joining
the Commission, can request a copy of the list of commitments so they can determine whether they
wish to join. Commissioner Sanchez provided insights on the need for multiple announcer stages
throughout the parade route. Vice Chair Ang made a motion to add announcer duties for the Annual
Arturo Sanchez Sr. Halloween Parade to the Commissions responsibilities and Chair Leon seconded
the motion. There being no objection, the motion carried. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioner
Sanchez if a date for the parade has been determined. Commissioner Sanchez stated they are still
looking at possible dates and will provide updates at future meetings so Mrs. Ocegueda can update
the list of meetings and activities for the Commission.

Home and Business Beautification Contest

Commissioners viewed and scored the submissions for the 2024 Home and Business Beautification
Contest. Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners for their suggestions to establish contest “rules” that
staff can follow for future contestant entries. Commissioner Sanchez recommended requesting 3
photos of the property, a view of the home from across the street, a right-side and a left-side view.
Commissioner Beacham suggested adding a comment that the pictures submitted is the base of how
the Commission votes upon. Vice Chair Ang asked staff if residents are allowed to change the parkway
landscaping. Mrs. Ocegueda stated they can only if they obtain approval from the Public
Services/Engineering division first as they have restrictions on the amount and type of materials that
can be placed in the parkway due to the utility lines that run underneath. Mrs. Ocegueda informed
Commissioners that one property was entered into two different categories and asked Commissioners
 how to proceed if this situation occurs again. Commissioners agreed a property should be entered into
only one category and if a property is submitted into multiple categories, the Commission will decide
what category they will place the entry in. Commission Ang commented on the low participation in the
Interior Business Appeal category and asked staff if they utilize the Chamber of Commerce to promote
the contest to businesses. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she was not aware the Commission used the
Chamber of Commerce before to help promote but will reach out in the future. Commissioner Beacham
suggested collaborating on social media with the Chamber for promotion and asked if a calendar of
Chamber events could be provided to the Commission. Mrs. Ocegueda stated she will reach out to the
Chamber of Commerce to obtain a calendar of events.

Commissioner’s Meet & Greet Event

Mrs. Ocegueda provided the Commission with food quotes from Sweet Lou’s BBQ, So Cal Pizza, and
Northgate Market. Commissioners unanimously decided on So Cal Pizza to cater the event.
Commissioner Sanchez inquired about utensils, drinks, and desserts. Mrs. Ocegueda will ask the
caterer about providing plates and utensils, drinks and desserts will be purchased at either Costco or
Sam’s Club. Mrs. Ocegueda reminded Chair Leon that she will be speaking on behalf of the
Commission, conducting the welcome, an ice breaker game, and introductions. Chair Leon informed
the Commission that she has another surgery scheduled in May but was hoping by the time of the event
she will be able to participate. Mrs. Ocegueda indicated that if Chair Leon was unable to make the
event, Vice Chair Ang would need to take over her duties. Mrs. Ocegueda provided Commissioners
with a copy of the changes Commissioner Beacham suggested for the Sponsorship letter and if any
other Commissioners had any changes, they should be emailed to her by the end of the week so they
can be incorporated. Commissioner Beacham asked if the businesses they wish to approach for
sponsorship must be in Norwalk. Chair Leon stated to stay within Norwalk as much as possible but
they can expand outside the city to help promote Norwalk as a business opportunity city.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Santa Ana showed the “Keeping It Norwalk” Campaign, the March Bagel edition video to
Commissioners. Mrs. Ocegueda informed Commissioners that the voting for the April Burritos edition
will end on Wednesday and staff will be out on Thursday to film.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Ms. Santa Ana provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s
overall reach across all outreach platforms for the last month. Ms. Santa Ana stated an increase in the
engagement rate and YouTube subscribers due to the City’s increased social media and video
production content output that ensures our interactions resonate deeper with our audience, which
increases engagement and connection with the community.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda notified Commissioners that the meeting scheduled for May 13, 2024 needed to be
rescheduled due to staff being unavailable to attend. Commissioners decided on moving the meeting
to the following Monday, May 20, 2024.
 COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Commissioner Beacham asked for an update regarding providing a phone number or Zoom link for the
public to participate and provide feedback during the Community Promotion Commission meetings
instead of being physically present. Ms. Santa Ana would follow up with Mr. Sun for an update.
Commissioner Sanchez asked what was supplies needed to be purchased with the chosen caterer.
Mrs. Ocegueda read a list of items that needed to be purchased. Vice Chair Ang asked if any items
were collected by Commissioners for the event, was there space available for storage. Mrs. Ocegueda
stated that the department has a small storage space that can be utilized until the day of the event.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:03 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
